QUOTE: "The `code` notice says reads are live and only writes are affected, after an earlier message gave a false all-clear (gh#348)." Also: "Until then, `build_or_refresh` refuses ... `_data_stale` checks `matches_source` first so auto-refresh never attempts a build that could drop layers."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that on the code axis reads are live while only writes/builds are affected, and that builds are refused to avoid dropping layers (old pipeline logic), though it doesn't spell out the per-call database opening.
